title: Death Note MC
description: This Minecraft mod adds the features from the anime Death Note in a Minecraft style.
body:
This mod adds features from the popular anime Death Note in a Minecraft style such as:
- Your own personal Shinigami
- Death Notes
- The ability to observe peoples names by punching them after making a deal to remove four
  health points
- Slightly cooler bits of paper (torn pages)
- A Death Note embedded into the ground (really rare, you'll probably never find one).

Best enjoyed in multiplayer!
